description:
£120 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this smart three-bedroom ground-floor flat on Dinsdale Road, a popular location for students.

The property offers three well-proportioned double bedrooms, each furnished with a bed frame, alongside a contemporary open-plan lounge and kitchen area. The flat benefits from wood-effect laminate flooring throughout, fresh decoration and a newly refurbished shower room. Further features include a large rear yard and a boiler and heating system that are insured and serviced by British Gas, providing added peace of mind.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
